regions.region: page 3 left Table 2 header, all displayed product arrows, times/yields/dr labels, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Forty displayed scope arrows plus the separately narrated free-OH failure were retained independently. Standard 1 mmol conditions, the 5 mmol repeat, footnote reagent overrides, 40 °C runs, recoveries, not-formed result, and displayed dr values were structured.
Five distinct mechanistic experiments were retained: CD3OD capture, TEMPO trapping, radical clock, and separate terminal/nonterminal alkyne controls, including all recoveries and non-formed products.
Int-1–Int-8 and the CF3 reductive-elimination branch are a proposed mechanism, not isolated reaction records.
Narrative failures, substituent groupings, and protected-hydroxyl distinction were linked to matching scope records; no aggregate range was substituted for row yields.

Complex product drawings remain label-only where exact encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 3 reaction header, nine product arrows, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Nine independent TMSCF3 experiments were retained with DMF versus DMSO conditions, row times/yields, and 1f/1p recoveries.

Ten downstream experiments were separated by arrow: one two-product borylcupration, two cross-couplings, NIS iodination, two DIBAL-H conditions, three one-step 19aa transformations, and one ordered two-step 19aa-to-28 sequence with an overall yield.
